thread:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PAGE 2034567890 — node-ssd-14 reporting ephemeral disk pressure > 95% in us-west-2. Several model-cache pods (modelcache-usw2-*) are being OOMKilled and some runtime containers crashed with CUDA errors. Impact: serving errors and increased latencies for a subset of Dedicated customers. Paging @thomas_oncall and @sasha_sre.

thomas_oncall: seeing it. thanks. starting triage. who's oncall for runtime?

maria_runtime: @thomas_oncall i'm on runtime. quick check: kube events show repeated eviction warnings then oom/killed and container restart loops. suspect log and modelcache growth.

sasha_sre: allocating. node-ssd-14 also shows dmesg I/O errors + ext4 writeback stalls. possible disk saturated by /var/lib/modelcache and /var/log/serve-runtime.

jamie_ops: confirming, modelcache disk usage spiked from ~40% to >92% in 3 mins. we've got hot models (long-tail prompts) causing cache bloat. logs rotated? not enough space for journals.

eric_prod: customers reporting 502s and timeouts. active incidents: customer-A (high QPS) and customer-B experiencing degraded throughput.

thomas_oncall: immediate aims: 1) stop further cache writes 2) reduce logging verbosity 3) restore node stability. Propose: scale down replica counts for affected model-sets, cordon node-ssd-14, evict non-critical pods, and restart modelcache with smaller cache-size. Anyone object?

maria_runtime: go for it. steps:
- cordon node-ssd-14: `kubectl cordon node-ssd-14`
- drain non-critical pods (exclude serving-critical): `kubectl drain node-ssd-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector='role!=serve'`
- scale down modelcache deployments to 0/1 depending on group: `kubectl scale deploy/modelcache-<group> --replicas=1`

sasha_sre: while that's happening, i can mount ephemeral volume metrics and start streaming `du -h` over top dirs. also request to rotate logs:

jamie_ops: patch to runtime log level:
```
kubectl -n serve patch deployment serve-runtime -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"serve","env":[{"name":"LOG_LEVEL","value":"error"}]}]}}}}'
```

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: reduce-log-level -> apply to namespace serve (CI pipeline id 7782)

thomas_oncall: exec plan now. maria, can you take node cordon + drain? sasha, start du stream and collect top 20 files. jamie, patch log level and scale down cache. i'll handle customer comms.

maria_runtime: started cordon+drain. drain blocked on a local-emptyDir pod (persistent scratch) — adding force delete for ephemeral. running:
```
kubectl delete pod scratch-helper-67 --grace-period=0 --force -n infra
```

sasha_sre: du output attached inline:
```
/var/lib/modelcache/large-model-v2/weights.bin  42G
/var/lib/modelcache/large-model-v1/weights.bin  38G
/var/log/serve-runtime/debug.log               12G
/var/log/serve-runtime/requests.log            9G
/tmp/runtime-swap                              6G
```
Looks like two large models dominate. will generate eviction list.

jamie_ops: scaled modelcache groups down and applied log-level patch. modelcache pods restarted with `--cache-size=4G` override. watching disk usage.

thomas_oncall: node cordoned and drained. non-critical pods moved. modelcache restarted. any CUDA errors still in crashes?

maria_runtime: seeing fewer CUDA errors; prior stacktrace was `CudaError: out of memory while allocating 32949632 bytes` from /serve/runtime/torch_backend. restarts reduced. disk usage dropped to 78% after evicting two model weights and truncating debug.log.

eric_prod: customer-A still has elevated latency but no 502s now. customer-B restored full throughput. continuing monitoring.

sasha_sre: filing a follow-up action: we need eviction policy for model cache on disk pressure and auto-shrink behavior. raising a postmortem ticket.

thomas_oncall: agreed. short-term mitigation checklist completed. will keep node offline until we confirm fs health. next: create pagerduty follow-up for root-cause and schedule PM to add LRU eviction on disk threshold. tagging SRE and Runtime.

customer-support: i've posted an incident update to affected customers: brief summary and ETA for follow-up. will send full RCA after postmortem.

thomas_oncall: thanks team. handing off to sasha for postmortem and maria for runtime follow-up. i'm clear for now, closing the active page. :white_check_mark:

sasha_sre: taking postmortem. collecting logs + metrics. will set ticket `INC-2034567890` and assign.

pagerbot: Incident closed by thomas_oncall at 2034568210.
